definition.name: [Palo Alto Networks Firewall] BGP peer {{peer.name}} ({{peer_ip.name}}) is down on {{device_ip.name}}

description: Tracks the session state of each BGP peer on the firewall. A peer that leaves the established state stops exchanging routes, which can blackhole or reroute traffic. On an active/passive HA pair, the passive firewall does not run dynamic routing, so its peers alert until a failover.
title: BGP peer is not established
